detail.title: ASEAN's Economic Rise: Opportunity or Reckoning for South Korea

publicationDetails.detailsText: KIEP Research Paper, KIEP Opinions No. 336
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Recently, the Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) and the Asian Development Bank (ADB) projected that major ASEAN countries will record economic growth rates in the mid-4% range or higher in 2026. Despite global high interest rates, U.S.–China tensions, geopolitical uncertainty, and the spread of protectionism, the ASEAN regional economy is expected to maintain relatively robust growth, supported by export recovery, domestic demand stimulation, and increased inflows of foreign direct investment (FDI). This outlook indicates that ASEAN continues to function as a key growth engine in the global economy. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 本文预测2026年主要东盟国家经济增长率将在4%以上，尽管面临高利率、中美紧张、地缘不确定性和保护主义，但受出口复苏、内需刺激和FDI流入支撑，东盟仍是全球经济的关键增长引擎。
AI.research_question: 东盟国家在2026年的经济增长前景如何？支撑其增长的关键因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 在全球经济面临高利率、地缘政治冲突和保护主义抬头等多重挑战的背景下，评估东盟地区作为全球增长引擎的韧性和前景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济增长理论、国际经济学中关于出口驱动增长、FDI溢出效应以及内需拉动增长的相关理论。
AI.method: 基于KIEP和ADB等机构的宏观经济预测数据进行前瞻性分析。
AI.findings: 主要东盟国家2026年经济增长率预计在4%以上；出口复苏、内需刺激和FDI流入是主要支撑因素；东盟在全球经济中继续扮演关键增长引擎角色。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了在多重外部冲击下，新兴经济体仍可通过多元驱动（出口+内需+FDI）维持增长韧性的理论观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供东盟经济前景的预判，指导区域合作与投资决策。

title: Climate Risks and Private Infrastructure Valuation
affiliations: EDHEC Business School and EDHEC Business School

detail.title: Climate Risks and Private Infrastructure Valuation

publicationDetails.journalName: BAFFI Centre on Economics, Finance & Regulation Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines how climate-related news affects the cost of capital for private infrastructure investment across countries. We combine a novel dataset of global infrastructure transactions with country-level measures of climate sentiment constructed from GDELT news data, alongside indicators of climate policy stringency and physical risk. We find that climate-related information is systematically incorporated into asset valuations: more adverse climate news is associated with lower valuation multiples, consistent with higher required returns, while more favorable news increases valuations. In contrast, we find no significant effects on realized returns, suggesting that climate information primarily operates through ex-ante adjustments in discount rates rather than realized cash flows. The effects are stronger in countries with higher transition risk and weaker institutional environments. These findings highlight the role of information in shaping financing conditions and suggest that climate-related narratives can influence the allocation of capital during the energy transition by affecting the cost of infrastructure investment.

AI.tldr: 本文利用全球基础设施交易数据与GDELT新闻构建的气候情绪指标，发现气候相关新闻通过影响折现率（而非现金流）系统性地改变私人基础设施投资的资本成本，且该效应在转型风险高、制度环境弱的国家更为显著。
AI.research_question: 气候相关新闻如何影响各国私人基础设施投资的资本成本？
AI.motivation: 理解气候信息如何通过影响融资条件进而影响能源转型期间的资本配置，特别是私人基础设施投资这一关键领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息传导机制与资产定价理论——气候新闻通过影响投资者预期的折现率（而非现金流）来改变资产估值。
AI.method: 将全球基础设施交易数据集与基于GDELT新闻数据构建的国家层面气候情绪指标相结合，同时纳入气候政策严格度和物理风险指标，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）不利气候新闻导致估值倍数降低（隐含更高要求回报率），有利新闻提高估值；（2）气候信息对已实现回报无显著影响，表明其主要通过事前折现率调整而非现金流渠道发挥作用；（3）在转型风险高、制度环境薄弱的国家，该效应更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了气候信息影响资本成本的具体机制——折现率渠道而非现金流渠道，拓展了气候金融与资产定价交叉领域的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供了气候叙事影响基础设施融资条件的实证证据，提示在能源转型中需关注气候信息传播对资本配置的潜在影响。

title: A Cohort Perspective on Latin America's Fertility Transition
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - University of California, San Diego and University of California, San Diego (UCSD)

detail.title: A Cohort Perspective on Latin America's Fertility Transition
detail.abstract:
Latin America's momentous fertility transition is now in the domain of history, allowing a cohort perspective on the decline of completed fertility. Using census microdata from 17 Latin American countries, we track female birth cohorts from the 1920s to the 1970s by subnational region to document the extent to which cohort fertility decline coincided with other demographic and socioeconomic processes. Across cohorts within subnational regions, children ever born fell one-for-one with mortality decline. Expansions in urbanization, multigenerational living, women's and husbands' education, women's employment, and the non-agricultural sector all predicted declines in ever-born and surviving fertility, but women's education and sectoral composition were the dominant forces after covariate adjustment. Fertility decline was not systematically linked with improvements in children's outcomes, including school enrollment, literacy, primary completion, and non-employment. These cohort facts challenge theories of fertility decline centered on women's work and children's education but support others emphasizing women's education.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用17个拉美国家的人口普查微观数据，追踪1920-1970年代女性生育队列，发现队列生育率下降与死亡率下降呈一对一关系，女性教育和产业结构是生育率下降的主导因素，而生育率下降与儿童教育及就业改善无系统关联。
AI.research_question: 拉丁美洲女性队列生育率下降在多大程度上与其他人口和社会经济过程（死亡率下降、城市化、教育、就业、产业结构等）同步发生？
AI.motivation: 拉丁美洲的生育转型已成为历史事实，但缺乏从队列视角对已完成生育率的系统分析，以及生育率下降与多重社会经济因素的协变关系研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生育率下降理论（包括强调女性工作与儿童教育的理论，以及强调女性教育的理论）
AI.method: 利用17个拉美国家的人口普查微观数据，将女性出生队列从1920年代追踪到1970年代，按次国家区域进行队列分析，采用协变量调整的回归分析。
AI.findings: （1）队列生育率与死亡率呈一对一下降关系；（2）城市化、多代同堂、女性及丈夫教育、女性就业、非农产业扩张均预测生育率下降，但协变量调整后女性教育和产业结构是主导因素；（3）生育率下降与儿童入学率、识字率、小学完成率和非就业率无系统关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了以女性工作和儿童教育为核心的生育率下降理论，支持了强调女性教育作用的生育率理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为拉美地区生育率下降的历史模式提供了系统的队列层面实证证据，有助于理解发展中地区生育转型的驱动因素。

title: 'Nobody Wants to Work Anymore': Lifetime Labor Market Experiences and the Decline of Male LFP in the United States
affiliations: University of Connecticut and University of Connecticut

detail.title: 'Nobody Wants to Work Anymore': Lifetime Labor Market Experiences and the Decline of Male LFP in the United States
detail.abstract:
Male labor force participation has declined steadily for 50 years in the United States. We show that one cause has been changes in men's beliefs about the returns to work, shaped by lifetime experiences of the aggregate male labor market. We find that experience effects on participation persist for men who move across state lines, are stronger for same-race male experiences, and are driven by formative childhood years. We also document effects of experiences on direct measures of labor market expectations. Our findings suggest that experience effects can turn short-run declines in labor demand into long-run declines in labor supply.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 美国男性劳动参与率持续50年下降，部分原因在于男性根据自身经历形成的对劳动回报的信念变化。童年时期的宏观劳动力市场经历会长期影响预期和参与决策，使短期需求下降转化为长期供给减少。
AI.research_question: 美国男性劳动参与率持续下降的原因是什么？经历（experience effects）如何通过影响信念改变劳动供给？
AI.motivation: 美国男性劳动参与率已持续下降50年，传统解释（如贸易、技术、福利政策等）未能完全说明这一长期趋势，本文试图从信念形成与经历效应的角度提供新的解释机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经历效应（experience effects）：个体根据自身经历的劳动力市场状况形成对劳动回报的信念；人力资本与劳动供给理论；预期形成与信念更新理论。
AI.method: 利用跨州迁移样本识别经历效应（排除地区固定效应）；比较同种族与非同种族经历的效应差异；检验童年时期（形成性阶段）经历的影响；结合劳动力市场预期的直接度量进行验证。
AI.findings: （1）经历效应对跨州迁移的男性仍然显著，排除地区特征干扰；（2）同种族男性经历的影响更强；（3）童年时期的形成性经历是关键驱动因素；（4）经历效应会直接影响男性的劳动市场预期。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经历效应引入劳动供给研究，提出信念渠道解释长期参与率下降；揭示短期劳动力需求冲击通过经历效应转化为长期供给下降的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国男性劳动参与率长期下降提供新视角；提示政策制定者应关注劳动力市场经历对个体信念的持久影响，尤其是在经济衰退期间对年轻一代的冲击。

title: Dollar Erosion: Understanding the Loss of Reserve Currency Status
affiliations: , Stanford Graduate School of Business, Stanford University and New York University (NYU) - Department of Finance

detail.title: Dollar Erosion: Understanding the Loss of Reserve Currency Status
detail.abstract:
We quantify the impact of the loss of reserve currency status in goods and asset markets. In goods markets, the loss of seigniorage (1% of GDP per annum) makes American households spend less, mostly on U.S. goods, leaving an excess supply of U.S. goods to be cleared by a real depreciation of the dollar. The larger the home bias and the lower the elasticity of substitution between home and foreign goods, the larger the required depreciation. Standard parameters imply an 8.8% real depreciation of the dollar. In asset markets, about 50% of GDP in dollar bonds must be reabsorbed by home investors, raising the U.S. real interest rate. Standard parameters imply a 90 basis points rise, leading to an aggregate wealth loss of roughly one year of U.S. GDP.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了美国失去储备货币地位在商品市场和资产市场中的经济影响。商品市场：年铸币税损失（GDP的1%）导致美国家庭减少支出，美元需实际贬值8.8%以出清过剩供给；资产市场：约50% GDP的美元债券需由国内投资者吸收，真实利率上升90基点，财富损失约等于一年美国GDP。
AI.research_question: 美国失去储备货币地位后，在商品市场和资产市场上会产生怎样的量化经济影响？
AI.motivation: 储备货币地位为美国带来铸币税收益和资产市场便利收益，但这一地位可能因地缘政治、财政赤字或替代货币崛起而丧失。量化这一冲击的规模，对理解国际货币体系演变具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于开放宏观经济学的一般均衡框架，结合商品市场的本国偏好与替代弹性、资产市场的债券再吸收机制，分析储备货币地位丧失的传导渠道。
AI.method: 理论建模与数值模拟。使用标准参数校准，模拟商品市场（铸币税损失→支出减少→汇率调整）和资产市场（债券回流→利率上升→财富损失）的均衡效应。
AI.findings: 1）商品市场：铸币税损失（GDP的1%）导致美元实际贬值8.8%，贬值幅度取决于本国偏好程度和替代弹性；2）资产市场：约50% GDP的美元债券需被国内吸收，真实利率上升90个基点；3）总体财富损失约等于一年美国GDP。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化储备货币地位丧失的双市场效应（商品+资产）；揭示了本国偏好和替代弹性对汇率调整的关键调节作用；将铸币税损失与债券回流机制纳入统一分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估去美元化风险提供量化基准（8.8%贬值、90bp利率上升、一年GDP的财富损失）；提示美国维持储备货币地位的经济价值，以及失去该地位后的调整成本规模。

title: Reconciling Micro Elasticities with the Macro Decline in Labor Supply
affiliations: University of Minnesota - Minneapolis

detail.title: Reconciling Micro Elasticities with the Macro Decline in Labor Supply
detail.abstract:
Micro estimates of the Marshallian elasticity of labor supply are small and typically positive, whereas cross-country and time-series patterns of hours imply a strong negative relationship between wages and hours. I reconcile these two apparently contradictory observations using a single utility specification and taking into account heterogeneity in non-labor income. Micro estimates condition on non-labor income, while macro variation allows capital income to adjust alongside labor income, which strengthens the income effect. A model with heterogeneous households and exogenous capital income yields closed-form expressions in which the distribution of the labor share shapes the gap between the micro and the macro elasticities. A cross-sectional regression of hours on wages that conditions on the labor share recovers the macro elasticity. A dynamic model with heterogeneous households and incomplete asset markets reproduces both elasticities as outcomes when disciplined by joint moments of wages, hours, consumption, and wealth. The income effects that bridge the gap between the two elasticities imply marginal propensities to earn that lie in the range of estimates of micro studies on lottery winners.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过考虑非劳动收入的异质性，调和了微观劳动供给弹性小且为正、而宏观工资与工时负相关的矛盾。核心在于微观估计条件于非劳动收入，宏观中资本收入随劳动收入调整增强了收入效应。
AI.research_question: 如何调和微观劳动供给弹性（小且为正）与宏观工资-工时负相关（大且为负）之间的看似矛盾的现象？
AI.motivation: 微观估计的Marshallian劳动供给弹性通常很小且为正，而跨国和时间序列数据却显示工资与工时之间存在强烈的负相关关系，这两种观察结果看似矛盾，需要理论统一解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: Marshallian劳动供给弹性；收入效应与替代效应；异质性家庭模型；非劳动收入（资本收入）差异；劳动份额分布；不完全资产市场
AI.method: 理论推导（封闭解）与动态模型（异质性家庭、不完全资产市场），结合微观数据矩（工资、工时、消费、财富）对模型进行校准和检验。
AI.findings: （1）微观弹性条件于非劳动收入，宏观弹性中资本收入随劳动收入调整，收入效应更强；（2）劳动份额的分布决定了微观与宏观弹性之间的差距；（3）控制了劳动份额的横截面回归可以恢复宏观弹性；（4）弥合两种弹性的收入效应所隐含的边际收入倾向与彩票中奖者微观研究估计范围一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的理论框架，解释了微观和宏观劳动供给弹性差异的来源——非劳动收入异质性和资本收入的内生调整，并推导出两者关系的解析表达式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为劳动经济学和宏观经济学中关于劳动供给行为、税收政策评估以及收入分配研究提供了统一的微观基础，有助于更准确地预测政策变化对总劳动供给的影响。

title: The Ghost in the Index: Knowledge Exclusion and the Fallacy of the Low-Resource Label: A Position Paper

detail.title: The Ghost in the Index: Knowledge Exclusion and the Fallacy of the Low-Resource Label: A Position Paper

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest

detail.abstract: The term low-resource languages is now widely used in machine intelligence to describe languages with limited digital data, annotated corpora, and processing tools. Yet this label hides major scientific, social, and methodological problems. It defines languages and communities by what they supposedly lack instead of recognizing their knowledge systems, communicative richness, memory structures, and cultural complexity. The term also obscures the historical, economic, and political causes of digital exclusion, including colonial infrastructures, unequal funding, platform concentration, and selective technological investment. In practice, many current machine intelligence pipelines are designed around written text and standardized orthographies, often relying on dominant databases and benchmarks that privilege text-only formats while excluding oral, gestural, performative, and multimodal forms of communication. As a result, they fail to process forms of communication that are central to many audioliterate populations, including oral narratives, prosody, rhythm, intonation, gesture, mimicry, facial expression, silence, and collective interaction. Current text-centered architectures remain poorly adapted to direct textless audio-to-audio systems, despite the fact that such pipelines are essential for communities where knowledge transmission is primarily oral. This limitation reflects a broader absence of sensory machine intelligence capable of integrating sound, embodiment, context, and multimodal social meaning. The label also encourages extractive forms of research in which communities are treated mainly as sources of raw data, often without reciprocity, long-term collaboration, or local technological benefit. The term lacks operational precision. It fails to distinguish between data scarcity, absence of digital infrastructure, exclusion from dominant technological systems, and sociopolitical marginalization. A more rigorous and community-centered vocabulary is therefore necessary for scientifically accurate and multi-scale ethically responsible research.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了"低资源语言"这一术语在机器智能领域的使用，指出其掩盖了科学、社会和方法论问题，并呼吁建立更严谨、以社区为中心的术语体系。
AI.research_question: "低资源语言"这一术语在机器智能领域的使用存在哪些科学、社会和方法论问题？如何构建更严谨的替代性术语体系？
AI.motivation: "低资源语言"标签隐含了基于缺失的界定方式，掩盖了数字排斥的历史、经济和政治根源，且当前以文本为中心的机器智能架构无法处理口头、多模态等非文本交流形式，导致提取式研究泛滥，亟需术语革新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语言与权力批判理论、后殖民技术研究、多模态交流理论、感官机器智能理论
AI.method: 概念批判与理论分析，结合对当前机器智能管道（pipeline）设计缺陷的技术性剖析
AI.findings: "低资源语言"术语存在五大问题：（1）以"匮乏"定义语言和社区；（2）掩盖殖民基础设施、不平等资助等数字排斥的结构性成因；（3）文本中心架构排斥口头、手势、表演等多模态交流；（4）鼓励提取式研究，缺乏互惠合作；（5）缺乏操作精确性，混淆数据稀缺、基础设施缺失、技术排斥与社会边缘化。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"低资源语言"标签中隐含的技术殖民主义与认知不平等，为后殖民技术研究和批判数据研究提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 推动机器智能领域重新审视术语使用，倡导向无文本音频到音频系统及感官机器智能方向发展，提出以社区为中心、多尺度伦理负责任的研究范式。

title: Before the Exodus? Young Scientists and the Future of US Science
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management, Harvard University - Strategy Unit and Monash University

detail.title: Before the Exodus? Young Scientists and the Future of US Science
detail.abstract:
Shortly after major policy changes to US science funding began in early 2025, we surveyed 916 young biomedical scientists – PhD students and postdoctoral researchers – about their career intentions and expectations. The results document a dramatic shift in sentiment. Barely half of respondents now say they are likely to remain in academia, down 22 percentage points from how they felt six months earlier. The fraction likely to stay in the United States fell by 21 percentage points. Even satisfaction with having pursued a PhD in science declined by 16 percentage points. These are not the complaints of established scientists defending their budgets, but rather the stated intentions of the next generation – the scientists who would, in ordinary times, become the principal investigators of the future.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 2025年初美国科学资助政策重大变化后，一项针对916名青年生物医学科学家（博士生和博士后）的调查显示，仅半数受访者表示可能留在学术界（下降22个百分点），留在美国的比例下降21个百分点，对攻读博士学位的满意度下降16个百分点，反映出下一代科研人才的大规模流失倾向。
AI.research_question: 2025年初美国科学资助政策重大变化后，青年生物医学科学家（博士生和博士后）的职业意图和预期发生了怎样的变化？
AI.motivation: 2025年初美国科学资助政策发生重大变化，亟需了解政策变动对下一代科研人才（而非已确立地位的资深科学家）的职业意向和留任意愿的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、职业选择理论、科学社会学中的科研人才流动与留任理论。
AI.method: 大规模问卷调查，样本量为916名青年生物医学科学家（博士生和博士后），采用前后对比设计（与六个月前的感受进行比较）。
AI.findings: （1）仅半数受访者表示可能留在学术界，较六个月前下降22个百分点；（2）留在美国的比例下降21个百分点；（3）对攻读博士学位的满意度下降16个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证揭示了重大政策变动对青年科研人才职业决策的即时冲击效应，拓展了科学政策与人才流动关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了青年科研人才流失的量化证据，警示科学资助政策变动可能削弱未来科研人才梯队，建议关注政策调整对下一代科学家的非预期负面影响。

title: Buddhist Economics as a Blueprint for a Post-Capitalist Circular World
affiliations: Global College (Malta), Global College (Malta)

detail.title: Buddhist Economics as a Blueprint for a Post-Capitalist Circular World
detail.abstract: Modern macroeconomic paradigms, rooted in Western classical theory, prioritize maximal consumption and physical growth at the expense of ecological stability. This paper examines the historical trajectory of this environmental crisis, from Adam Smith's growth-centric foundations to the modern globalized economy's contribution to climate change. Recognizing the structural failures of both capitalist exploitation and historical socialist alternatives, this study proposes Buddhist economics as a necessary psychological and structural alternative. By replacing the goal of maximal consumption with optimal well-being, Buddhist economics aligns seamlessly with the modern framework of the circular economy. Through a case study of Bhutan's Gross National Happiness (GNH) and carbon-negative initiatives, alongside a comparative empirical analysis of GNH and GDP frameworks, this paper argues that true sustainable development requires an internal shift in human consciousness rather than mere cosmetic regulatory adjustments.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了以增长为核心的现代宏观经济学范式，提出佛教经济学作为替代方案，通过不丹案例论证从最大化消费转向最优福祉是实现可持续发展的根本路径。
AI.research_question: 如何超越以增长为导向的西方经济范式，构建一种兼顾生态稳定与人类福祉的替代性经济体系？
AI.motivation: 资本主义增长范式和传统社会主义模式均未能解决生态危机；全球气候变化等环境问题日益严峻，亟需从心理和结构层面进行根本性变革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 佛教经济学（以最优福祉替代最大消费）、循环经济理论、国民幸福指数（GNH）框架。
AI.method: 不丹GNH与碳负排放政策的案例研究；GNH与GDP框架的比较实证分析。
AI.findings: 佛教经济学与循环经济框架高度兼容；不丹的GNH政策实现了碳负排放；真正的可持续发展需要人类意识的内部转变，而非表面的规制调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 将佛教经济学与循环经济理论系统对接，提出"内在意识转变"是可持续发展的理论前提，挑战了以消费最大化为核心的传统经济学假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了不丹GNH作为可借鉴的替代发展模式；指出GDP框架的局限性，倡导以幸福感为核心的指标体系。

title: Pollinator Decline Reveals Uneven Impacts From Climate-driven Biodiversity Loss
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice, Università degli Studi di Milano and Ca’ Foscari University of Venice

detail.title: Pollinator Decline Reveals Uneven Impacts From Climate-driven Biodiversity Loss

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the European Union’s Assessing Climate Change Risk in EUrope (ACCREU) project (Grant Agreement No. 101081358; Funding scheme: HORIZON-CL5-2022-D1-07-two-stage).

detail.abstract:
Ecosystems and biodiversity sustain human welfare through essential services such as pollination, collectively contributing a significant proportion to global GDP. Yet their representation in long-term socioeconomic projections remains critically limited, leading to biased outlooks, particularly under accelerating environmental change. 

Here we develop the first long-term, climate-driven evaluation of pollination impacts, integrating biophysical and economic modelling of wild pollinator species and 129 crops to quantify how biodiversity loss propagates through agricultural systems into the macro-economy across 122 EU sub-national regions to 2070.

EU-wide average impacts, showing GDP losses up to €57.7 billion/year (-0.18\%) and agricultural sector losses of -1.5 to -6.0\% by 2070, systematically conceal severe spatial concentration of damages. Under high-emission scenarios, cropland productivity losses for vegetables, fruits and nuts reach -25.5\% in the most exposed regions, with sectorial economic impacts spanning between -21.35\% and +8.85\%. Mediterranean and eastern EU regions bear disproportionate burdens, amplifying intra-EU economic disparities. 

Our findings highlight the spatial heterogeneity of pollination decline and its uneven effects on pollinator-dependent crops across regions, revealing critical vulnerabilities in the agricultural systems. These results demonstrate that biodiversity impacts cannot be properly captured by national-scale assessments and that spatial resolution is not a technical choice but a determinant of whether risks are visible at all. Standard integrated assessment models, typically resolved at macro-regional level, may systematically underestimate the vulnerability to climate-biodiversity impacts as aggregation conceals distributional tails by factors of 2-5×.

AI.tldr: 本文首次开发了长期气候驱动的传粉服务影响评估模型，整合生物物理与宏观经济建模，预测到2070年欧盟122个次区域因传粉者减少导致的经济损失。研究发现GDP最高损失可达每年577亿欧元（-0.18%），高排放情景下部分地区蔬果产量损失达-25.5%，地中海和东欧地区负担最重，且空间异质性极强，国家层面的评估会系统性地低估风险2-5倍。
AI.research_question: 气候变化导致传粉者（野生传粉物种）减少如何通过农业系统传导至宏观经济？其空间异质性和分布性影响有多大？
AI.motivation: 生态系统和生物多样性通过传粉等关键服务支撑人类福祉，占全球GDP相当份额，但在长期社会经济预测中几乎被忽视，导致对未来发展的评估存在系统性偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生物多样性-生态系统服务-农业经济-宏观经济传导框架；空间异质性与聚集效应偏差理论；集成评估模型（IAM）的空间分辨率局限性。
AI.method: 整合生物物理模型（模拟野生传粉者物种变化）与经济模型（涵盖129种作物），对欧盟122个次区域进行气候情景驱动的动态模拟至2070年，分析传粉服务变化对作物产量、农业部门及整体宏观经济的级联影响。
AI.findings: （1）欧盟整体GDP损失可达每年577亿欧元（-0.18%），农业部门损失为-1.5%至-6.0%；（2）但均值掩盖了严重的空间集中损害，高排放情景下部分地区蔬果产量损失高达-25.5%，部门经济影响范围为-21.35%至+8.85%；（3）地中海和东欧地区负担最重，加剧了欧盟内部经济不平等；（4）国家层面或宏观区域层面的评估会因聚集效应低估分布尾部风险2-5倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将传粉服务损失纳入长期宏观经济预测框架，揭示了空间分辨率不是技术选择而是决定风险可见性的关键因素，证明了标准集成评估模型因宏观区域层面的聚集而系统性低估气候-生物多样性影响的脆弱性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及各国政策制定者提供了次区域级别的高分辨率风险评估，揭示了传粉者减少对农业系统和经济不平等加剧的潜在威胁，提示政策制定需要关注空间异质性和最脆弱地区，避免国家层面平均值掩盖关键风险。

title: Calibrated but Not Sharp: Stated Probabilities in Five-Minute Crypto Markets on Polymarket

detail.title: Calibrated but Not Sharp: Stated Probabilities in Five-Minute Crypto Markets on Polymarket
detail.abstract: When a prediction market shows a high chance, does the event happen that often, or is the price fooling you? This paper studies that for five-minute, USDC-denominated up/down contracts on Polymarket, across Bitcoin, Ether, Solana, and Dogecoin, and reports three findings. First, the prices are calibrated. Using a clean logger that records the implied probability of every active market at a fixed moment about a minute before close, whether or not anyone traded it, I obtain 14,808 contracts over sixteen days, and stated probabilities match realized frequencies to within about one percentage point across the range, including in the extreme tails. The slope of realized outcomes on stated probability is 1.01, and three small-sample methods built for sixteen day-clusters, a wild-cluster bootstrap, an Ibragimov-Muller test, and randomization inference, all fail to reject the value of 1.0; the intervals are wide enough that only a favorite-longshot bias larger than a few percent in slope terms is ruled out. This is reassuring but unsurprising, since a liquid market should price roughly like this. Second, and more useful as method, a separate large but selected dataset of about 209,000 trade entries shows how easily this can be gotten wrong: treating those correlated trades as independent manufactures a statistically significant favorite-longshot bias that vanishes under dependence-robust inference and is absent from the clean data. Third, calibration is not sharpness. The posted probabilities hug fifty-fifty even when the near-term outcome is largely decided. A costless rule that asks only which side is ahead at the snapshot calls the final direction about 81 percent of the time against the market's 64 percent, with more than double the Brier resolution, and this survives rebuilding the rule on a second, independent exchange feed. I therefore report the discrimination of the posted quote as low relative to freely available information, and stop short of calling it trader underreaction, because the logged value is a non-executable quote on a thin market and I have no spread or order-book data to rule out microstructure. Two limits bound everything: sixteen days on a single venue, and a deliberately extreme five-minute horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Polymarket上五种加密货币的短期（五分钟）预测市场价格校准程度，发现价格整体校准良好，但预测精度较低——尾部概率估计准确，但中间概率过于接近50%，无法充分利用公开信息进行精准预测。
AI.research_question: 预测市场中的短期合约价格是否准确校准？即当预测市场显示高概率时，事件是否真的以相应频率发生？
AI.motivation: 预测市场的价格校准问题对市场效率和信息聚合功能至关重要。以往研究因使用交易数据（存在相关性）可能得出错误结论，本文通过干净的快照数据检验价格校准，并区分"校准度"与"锐利度"两个不同概念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有效市场假说（价格反映信息）、预测市场校准理论、Favorite-Longshot Bias（热门-冷门偏差）理论、预测的校准度（calibration）与锐利度（sharpness/discrimination）区分。
AI.method: 收集Polymarket上比特币、以太坊、Solana、狗狗币的五分钟USDC计价涨跌合约在关闭前一分钟的隐含概率快照数据（14,808份合约，16天），分析校准曲线斜率；对比使用约209,000条交易数据的传统方法；采用依赖关系稳健的统计推断（Wild-cluster bootstrap、Ibragimov-Muller检验、随机化推断）；使用Brier评分和简单方向预测规则评估锐利度。
AI.findings: 1. 价格校准良好：前测概率与实现频率基本一致，斜率为1.01，极端尾部误差约1个百分点，未发现Favorite-Longshot偏差；2. 使用交易数据（含相关观测）会错误地制造出统计显著的Favorite-Longshot偏差，这是方法误差；3. 校准不等于锐利度：预测概率过度集中在50%附近，一个简单的"领先方向"规则（81%准确率）远优于市场报价（64%），说明市场报价的区分度低。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 区分了预测市场的"校准度"（calibration）与"锐利度"（sharpness/discrimination），指出前者良好不等于后者充分；2. 揭示了使用相关交易数据进行校准检验的方法论陷阱，证明传统方法可能错误识别Favorite-Longshot偏差；3. 对短期极端事件预测市场的有效性提出了细化的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为Polymarket等预测市场用户提供了价格准确性的实证基准；2. 为监管机构和市场设计者提供了评估预测市场质量的框架；3. 警示研究者和从业者避免使用非独立观测数据得出错误结论；4. 指出市场报价的局限性：即使校准良好，预测的锐利度可能不足，存在利用公开信息改进的空间。

title: The Closing Externality Window: First-Principles Sustainability and the Evidence for a Compressing Externality Lag

detail.title: The Closing Externality Window: First-Principles Sustainability and the Evidence for a Compressing Externality Lag

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of SustBridge AI, a sustainability-analytics company. SustBridge had no role in the design, data collection, analysis, or conclusions of this study, and the findings are not contingent on any commercial interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable — the study analyses publicly documented historical corporate cases; no human participants were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Corporate sustainability is conventionally argued by analogy — such as the performance of ESG funds, regulatory pressure, or consumer sentiment — and each such argument weakens as its underlying condition shifts. This paper instead documents a measurable empirical regularity and rebuilds the case for sustainability on it, as a problem in capital allocation rather than values. The evidence is a purpose-built dataset of 39 historical and contemporary cases, spanning 167 years of origination dates (1850–2017). The cases cover all three ESG pillars, admitted under a two-track materiality rule and balanced by pre-specified geographic, sector, and historical-depth guards. Across them, the latency to crystallisation has compressed at about two-thirds of a year per calendar year of origination (R² = 0.737, p < 0.0001). The relationship holds within each ESG pillar and across sensitivity tests, and is, if anything, conservative against right-censoring. Read economically, the window during which a cost can remain an unpriced externality is closing: externalities are internalised faster than they once were, and the mechanisms doing the compressing are largely non-legislative. From four first-principles premises the paper derives this claim, situates the empirical result within it, and organises the implications into a staged account — the First-Principles Sustainability flywheel — of how a compressing externality lag enters capital-allocation decisions of every kind, with project-finance and merger-and-acquisition due diligence its most immediate application. Two instruments that operationalise its central stages — a time-to-internalisation duration model and a breaking-point function for the act-versus-defer decision — are developed in a companion paper.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建跨越167年、涵盖39个历史与当代案例的专有数据集，发现外部性内部化的潜伏期以每年约三分之二年的速度压缩，并基于第一性原理推导出可持续性本质上是资本配置问题而非价值观问题，提出了"第一性原理可持续性飞轮"框架。
AI.research_question: 可持续性外部性内部化的时间滞后（潜伏期）是否在系统性压缩？这种压缩的机制是什么，以及它如何影响资本配置决策？
AI.motivation: 传统的可持续性论证基于类比（如ESG基金表现、监管压力、消费者情绪），但这些论证会随条件变化而弱化。本文试图从可测量的经验规律出发，将可持续性重新构建为资本配置问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第一性原理：从四个基本原则推导出外部性内部化滞后正在压缩的命题；非立法机制（市场、声誉、供应链压力等）是压缩的主要驱动力。
AI.method: 构建包含39个历史与当代案例（1850-2017年）的专有数据集，覆盖ESG三大支柱，采用双轨实质性规则，按预先指定的地理、行业和历史深度进行平衡。使用回归分析检验潜伏期与起源年份的关系。
AI.findings: 外部性内部化潜伏期以每年约三分之二年的速度压缩（R²=0.737, p<0.0001），该关系在三大ESG支柱内部及敏感性检验中均成立；压缩机制主要是非立法性的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了可持续性问题的第一性原理理论框架，将可持续性从价值观问题重新定义为资本配置问题；提出了"第一性原理可持续性飞轮"的阶段性理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为项目融资和并购尽职调查提供了直接应用工具（时间-内部化持续时间模型和行动-延期决策的临界点函数）；为企业和管理者提供了外部性内部化加速趋势下的战略决策框架。

title: DSP-Assisted Deep Learning for Transmission Line Fault Detection in Smart Grids Under Clean and Noisy Conditions
affiliations: City University

detail.title: DSP-Assisted Deep Learning for Transmission Line Fault Detection in Smart Grids Under Clean and Noisy Conditions
detail.abstract: This paper presents a deep learning-based fault detection system for smart grid transmission lines, addressing the critical need for robust and accurate fault identification to ensure grid stability and reliability. The proposed methodology integrates Digital Signal Processing (DSP) techniques for comprehensive feature extraction from raw current and voltage signals. Key DSP features, including instantaneous zero-sequence components, total magnitudes, and maximum instantaneous values, were derived to characterize various fault conditions. A multi-layer perceptron (MLP) deep learning model was then developed and trained on these engineered features.On a clean dataset, the model achieved exceptional performance with a test accuracy of 99.72%, and near-perfect precision, recall, and F1-scores of 1.00 for both fault and no-fault classes, as evidenced by a confusion matrix showing only 5 misclassifications out of 1801 samples. To assess robustness, the system was further evaluated using data augmented with Gaussian noise (mean=0, std=0.1). When retrained and tested on noisy data, the model maintained high performance, achieving a test accuracy of 99.22% and consistent precision, recall, and F1-scores of 0.99 across classes. This demonstrates the model's resilience to typical measurement uncertainties. The findings underscore the efficacy of combining DSP-engineered features with deep learning for highly accurate and robust fault detection in complex smart grid environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于深度学习（MLP）与数字信号处理（DSP）特征工程相结合的智能电网输电线路故障检测系统，在干净数据上达到99.72%的测试准确率，在含噪数据上仍保持99.22%的准确率，展现出高精度与强鲁棒性。
AI.research_question: 如何结合DSP特征提取与深度学习模型，实现智能电网输电线路故障的高精度、强鲁棒检测？
AI.motivation: 智能电网的稳定性与可靠性对故障检测系统的准确性和鲁棒性提出了极高要求，现有方法在测量噪声干扰下性能易退化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字信号处理（DSP）特征工程（瞬时零序分量、总幅值、最大瞬时值等）；多层感知器（MLP）深度学习模型；高斯噪声数据增强用于鲁棒性评估。
AI.method: 从原始电流电压信号中提取DSP特征，构建MLP深度学习模型进行训练与测试；在干净数据集和高斯噪声（均值0，标准差0.1）增强数据集上分别评估性能，使用准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数和混淆矩阵作为评价指标。
AI.findings: 干净数据集上测试准确率99.72%，故障与非故障类精确率、召回率、F1均为1.00，仅5个误分类样本；含噪数据上准确率99.22%，各指标均为0.99，模型展现出对测量噪声的强鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了DSP工程特征与深度学习结合在电力系统故障检测中的有效性，并证实该混合方法在噪声环境下仍保持高分类性能。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智能电网提供了一种高精度、抗噪声干扰的输电线路故障检测方案，可提升电网运行的安全性与可靠性。

title: The Information-Survival Ratio: A Within-Strategy Diagnostic of Conditioning Overfit in Walk-Forward Backtests
affiliations: University of Reading

detail.title: The Information-Survival Ratio: A Within-Strategy Diagnostic of Conditioning Overfit in Walk-Forward Backtests

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. The views expressed in this paper are those of the author and do not necessarily reflect those of Miralta Finance Bank, S.A.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external funding.

detail.abstract: When a researcher tests a conditional trading strategy in-sample using a rich set of conditioning variables, in-sample performance typically exceeds walk-forward performance. Existing diagnostics for this gap operate across strategies multiple-testing corrections that adjust observed Sharpe ratios for the implicit search across many candidate strategies. They are silent on a second source of overfitting that occurs within a single strategy: how much of the conditioning information used in-sample also survives walk-forward selection. We propose the information-survival ratio (ISR), a within-strategy diagnostic that addresses this second source. The researcher first specifies how much conditioning information to use in-sample, expressed as a Kullback-Leibler divergence from the unconditional benchmark. The diagnostic then asks how much of this budget walk-forward cross-validation keeps out-of-sample. A high ratio means the conditioning information survives; a low ratio means walk-forward reverts to the unconditional benchmark. We develop selection inference for the cross-fitted walk-forward argmax: a temporal buffer criterion, an exponential large-deviation rate under mixing and fixed positive separation, stationary block bootstrap validity, and a joint specification-budget extension. An application across equity, hedge fund, industry, and single-name panels finds that information survival varies substantially across asset classes, with hedge fund indices generally retaining the largest fraction of conditioning capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信息生存比（ISR），用于诊断单个条件交易策略中样本内使用的条件信息在样本外（滚动验证）中保留了多少，弥补了现有多重假设检验方法无法捕捉单一策略内过拟合的空白。
AI.research_question: 如何量化一个条件交易策略中样本内使用的条件信息在滚动验证（walk-forward）中幸存下来的比例？
AI.motivation: 现有诊断只关注跨策略的多重检验修正（如调整夏普比率），但忽略了单一策略内部因使用大量条件变量导致的过拟合——即样本内使用的条件信息在样本外被丢弃的程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. KL散度（Kullback-Leibler divergence）衡量条件信息量；2. 大偏差理论（large-deviation）用于极端值选择推断；3. 混合过程与固定正分离假设下的指数率；4. 平稳Bootstrap有效性。
AI.method: 开发交叉拟合滚动验证选择推断（cross-fitted walk-forward argmax），包括时间缓冲准则、指数大偏差率、平稳Bootstrap、联合规范-预算扩展。
AI.findings: 在股票、对冲基金、行业和单名称面板中，信息生存率在不同资产类别间差异显著，对冲基金指数保留的条件信息比例最高。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出信息生存比（ISR），填补单一策略内过拟合诊断的空白；2. 建立滚动验证选择推断的统计理论（大偏差率、Bootstrap一致性）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证资产定价和量化交易提供一项实用诊断工具，帮助研究者判断条件策略的样本内表现优势在样本外是否真实可信。

title: Incomplete Gamma Representations of the Riemann Xi Function: a Thorin Bernstein Framework
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Incomplete Gamma Representations of the Riemann Xi Function: a Thorin Bernstein Framework
detail.abstract: We study the analytic continuation of the completed zeta function ξ through its incomplete gamma representation and develop a probabilistic framework for it based on Thorin measures, generalized gamma convolutions (GGC) and hyperbolic complete monotonicity (HCM). The incomplete gamma form keeps the Gaussian building blocks of the theta function intact under continuation, which exposes a two tier structure: a trivial tier indexed by the squares πn 2 , which is unconditionally a ThorinBernstein subordinator and a GGC; and a nontrivial tier indexed by the squared ordinates  of the zeros, which is a GGC if and only if the Riemann Hypothesis holds. We give four equivalent faces of this equivalence (Thorin positivity, Thorin Bernstein, Stieltjes transform, and complete monotonicity of the Lévy density), a Hankel determinant (secondary zeta) moment criterion in the spirit of Li and Voros, and an explicit Jacobi theta density for the trivial tier. We survey the incomplete gamma representations of Lavrik Paris Cang, Haglund, and CrandallCoey, and read the latter inside the Thorin framework. Using Steutel's infinite divisibility criterion the engine of Kristiansen's proof that mixtures of Γ(α) are infinitely divisible i α ≤ 2we show that the incomplete gamma is a truncated stable Bernstein function, that truncation is exactly the GGC→ID gap, and we prove a new stable 1 2 multiplier theorem dual to Kristiansen's at the sharp HCM threshold. The exposition is self-contained and the analytic identities are veried numerically.

AI.tldr: 本文通过不完全伽马表示研究完备zeta函数ξ的解析延拓，基于Thorin测度、广义伽马卷积（GGC）和双曲完全单调性（HCM）建立了其概率框架。证明了平凡层（由平方πn²索引）无条件是一个Thorin-Bernstein子ordinator和GGC；而非平凡层（由零点纵坐标平方索引）是GGC当且仅当黎曼假设成立。给出了该等价性的四个等价表述，以及Hankel行列式矩准则和显式Jacobi theta密度。
AI.research_question: 如何通过概率框架（Thorin测度、GGC、HCM）刻画完备zeta函数ξ的解析结构，并建立其与黎曼假设的等价关系？
AI.motivation: 黎曼假设是数学中最重要的未解决问题之一。传统方法多从解析数论角度出发，本文尝试从概率论（无限可分性、完全单调性）角度重新审视zeta函数的解析延拓，为黎曼假设提供一个概率框架下的等价判定条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: Thorin测度（广义伽马卷积的混合表示）、广义伽马卷积（GGC）、双曲完全单调性（HCM）、Bernstein函数、Stieltjes变换、完全单调性、无限可分性、截断稳定过程
AI.method: 1. 利用不完全伽马表示进行解析延拓，保留theta函数的高斯结构；2. 建立Thorin-Bernstein子ordinator与GGC的概率框架；3. 证明平凡层与非平凡层的概率性质；4. 给出四个等价表述（Thorin正性、Thorin-Bernstein、Stieltjes变换、Lévy密度的完全单调性）；5. 构建Hankel行列式（次级zeta）矩准则；6. 利用Steutel无限可分性判据和Kristiansen定理证明不完全伽马是截断稳定Bernstein函数；7. 证明新的稳定1/2乘子定理。
AI.findings: 1. 平凡层（πn²索引）无条件为Thorin-Bernstein子ordinator和GGC；2. 非平凡层（零点纵坐标平方索引）为GGC当且仅当黎曼假设成立；3. 给出了黎曼假设概率等价的四个表述；4. 发现了GGC→ID的截断间隙（不完全伽马是截断稳定Bernstein函数）；5. 证明了一个新的稳定1/2乘子定理，与Kristiansen定理在HCM阈值处对偶。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了完备zeta函数与概率论（无限可分性、GGC、Thorin测度）之间的深层联系；2. 将黎曼假设转化为一个概率框架下的等价条件（非平凡层是否为GGC）；3. 揭示了不完全伽马函数作为截断稳定Bernstein函数的概率本质；4. 证明了GGC与更一般的无限可分性之间的精确间隙（截断机制）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了黎曼假设的概率等价判定条件，可能为数值验证或新的证明路径提供工具；2. 给出了显式的Jacobi theta密度和Hankel行列式准则，便于数值计算；3. 分析方法自包含，解析恒等式经过数值验证；4. 对无限可分性理论和截断稳定过程的研究有推动意义。

title: Digital Identity, Data Justice, and Human Capabilities: A Technology Impact Assessment of Uganda's National Identification System

detail.title: Digital Identity, Data Justice, and Human Capabilities: A Technology Impact Assessment of Uganda's National Identification System

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or institutional affiliations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study relied exclusively on publicly available documents, legislation, policy reports, academic publications, institutional reports, and secondary sources. No human participants were involved, and no primary data were collected. Consequently, formal institutional ethics review was not required. The study was conducted in accordance with principles of academic integrity, responsible research, and proper attribution of sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The paper was developed as part of the author's graduate studies in Global Technology and Development at Arizona State University. While the author is a Mastercard Foundation Scholar, the Foundation did not fund, commission, influence, or review this research.

detail.abstract:
Digital identity systems have emerged as a foundational component of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) and are increasingly promoted as instruments for improving service delivery, enhancing financial inclusion, strengthening state capacity, and advancing Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 16.9 on legal identity for all. Despite growing investment in national digital identity systems across Africa, existing scholarship remains divided between studies emphasizing developmental benefits and those highlighting risks of exclusion, surveillance, and governance failures. Few studies integrate these perspectives within a comprehensive Technology Impact Assessment (TIA) framework.

This paper applies a Technology Impact Assessment framework to evaluate Uganda's National Identification System and its implications for inclusion, human capabilities, and data justice. Drawing on Technology Impact Assessment scholarship, the Capability Approach, and Data Justice theory, the study examines how digital identity systems shape access to services, opportunities, and rights among different population groups. The analysis is based on qualitative document analysis of legal frameworks, policy documents, academic literature, civil society reports, and empirical studies relating to Uganda's digital identity ecosystem.

The findings indicate that Uganda's National Identification System has generated important benefits in civil identification, administrative coordination, financial inclusion, and service delivery. However, these benefits are unevenly distributed and accompanied by significant challenges, including registration barriers, exclusion of vulnerable populations, privacy concerns, governance weaknesses, and increasing dependency on digital identity for access to public services. Women, older persons, rural populations, and individuals lacking supporting documentation face disproportionate risks of exclusion. The analysis further demonstrates that the developmental value of digital identity systems cannot be assessed solely through enrollment rates or technical performance but must also consider their effects on substantive freedoms, participation, and equitable access to opportunities.

The paper contributes to scholarship on digital identity and Digital Public Infrastructure by integrating Technology Impact Assessment, the Capability Approach, and Data Justice into a single analytical framework. It argues that digital identity systems should be evaluated not only as technological infrastructures but also as governance and development infrastructures whose success depends on their ability to expand human capabilities, minimize exclusion, promote data justice, and support rights-based digital governance.

AI.tldr: 本文运用技术影响评估（TIA）框架，结合能力方法和数据正义理论，评估了乌干达国家身份识别系统对包容性、人类能力和数据正义的影响。研究发现该系统在民事身份识别、金融包容和服务交付方面带来了收益，但这些收益分布不均，弱势群体面临排斥、隐私和治理风险。文章主张数字身份系统应被视为治理和发展基础设施，其成功取决于扩展人类能力、减少排斥和促进数据正义的能力。
AI.research_question: 数字身份系统如何影响不同人群获得服务、机会和权利？具体而言，乌干达的国家身份识别系统在包容性、人类能力和数据正义方面产生了怎样的效果？
AI.motivation: 数字身份系统在非洲国家推广迅速，但现有研究存在二元对立——要么强调发展收益，要么聚焦排斥、监控和治理失败风险，缺乏将两种视角整合的综合评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术影响评估（TIA）框架、能力方法（Capability Approach）、数据正义理论（Data Justice）。
AI.method: 定性文献分析，包括对法律框架、政策文件、学术文献、公民社会报告和乌干达数字身份生态系统相关实证研究的分析。
AI.findings: 1. 乌干达国家身份识别系统在民事身份识别、行政协调、金融包容和服务交付方面产生了重要收益。2. 收益分布不均，伴随显著挑战：注册障碍、弱势群体排斥、隐私问题、治理薄弱、对数字身份的依赖性增强。3. 女性、老年人、农村人口和缺乏证明文件的个体面临不成比例的排斥风险。4. 数字身份系统的发展价值不能仅通过注册率或技术性能来评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 将技术影响评估、能力方法和数据正义整合为一个统一的分析框架，用于评估数字身份系统。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和实践者提供评估数字身份系统的综合视角，强调应从扩展人类能力、减少排斥、促进数据正义和基于权利的数字治理等维度评价数字身份系统，而非仅关注技术指标。

title: Beyond Mean-Variance: Goal-Based Portfolio Optimisation with Derivatives and Structured Products

detail.title: Beyond Mean-Variance: Goal-Based Portfolio Optimisation with Derivatives and Structured Products

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research did not involve human participants, animals, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper documents a research optimiser that builds goal-based portfolios beyond the classical mean-variance frame. It re-implements and extends a 2012 MSc thesis (USI Lugano) that replicated the mental-accounting models of Das & Statman (2009) and Das, Markowitz, Scheid & Statman (2010). Two engines are provided: an exact grid optimiser that reproduces the thesis results on a discretised state space, and a scalable Monte-Carlo + CVaR optimiser that escapes the curse of dimensionality through copula scenarios and a linear program. Both price derivatives and structured products arbitrage-consistently, and an out-of-sample backtest holds the chosen portfolio on later, unseen data. Beyond a faithful re-implementation, the paper records two substantive corrections relative to the thesis-the enforcement of the Expected-Shortfall constraint and the fair pricing of structured notes-and reports results, validation and limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文在经典均值-方差框架之外，构建了基于目标的投资组合优化器，包含精确网格优化器和可扩展的蒙特卡洛+CVaR优化器，并对2012年硕士论文进行了复现、扩展和修正。
AI.research_question: 如何构建超越经典均值-方差框架的、基于心理账户的目标导向投资组合优化器？
AI.motivation: 经典均值-方差框架无法充分捕捉投资者基于目标（如心理账户）的投资行为，需要更符合实际决策过程的投资组合构建方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 心理账户模型（Das & Statman, 2009; Das, Markowitz, Scheid & Statman, 2010）、期望损失约束、Copula场景生成、CVaR优化
AI.method: 两个引擎：1）精确网格优化器（离散状态空间）；2）可扩展的蒙特卡洛+CVaR优化器（使用Copula场景生成和线性规划规避维度诅咒）。两者均对衍生品和结构化产品进行无套利定价，并进行样本外回测。
AI.findings: 成功复现并扩展了心理账户投资组合模型；对原论文进行了两项实质性修正（期望损失约束的执行和结构化票据的公平定价）；两个优化器均能有效构建目标导向投资组合。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）在心理账户投资组合框架中引入CVaR优化和Copula场景生成，突破了维度诅咒；2）纠正了原论文中期望损失约束和结构化产品定价的理论缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了两种可用的目标导向投资组合优化工具（网格优化器和MC+CVaR优化器），可对衍生品和结构化产品进行无套利定价并支持样本外回测，对实际资产配置具有直接应用价值。

reference: Cornell Legal Studies Research Paper; Antitrust Law Journal (forthcoming)
title: Platforms and Antitrust: What Amex Could Learn from Microsoft
affiliations: Cornell University - Law School

detail.title: Platforms and Antitrust: What Amex Could Learn from Microsoft

publicationDetails.journalName: Cornell Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The economics of multi-sided platforms has important implications for antitrust. In its 2018 Amex decision, the Supreme Court held that, in cases involving "transaction platforms," the market must be defined to include both sides. Under this rule, a plaintiff cannot prove anticompetitive harm by showing a reduction in competition and welfare on one side; it must show a net harm across both sides combined. The Amex majority viewed this as necessary to account for indirect network effects, which create interdependence between the two sides of a platform. 

However, 25 years ago, Microsoft did precisely what Amex said was impossible: it carefully accounted for the interdependence between the consumers and software developers on an operating system, despite defining the market around just the consumer side. It did this by considering how the challenged conduct affected developer activity (particularly multihoming) and then accounting for how this would feed back onto competition and welfare on the consumer side. 

The Amex majority conflated three questions: (1) whether courts should "consider" both sides; (2) whether antitrust should permit benefits on one side to excuse anticompetitive harm on the other; and (3) how to define the market. The economics of platforms answers the first question - we must indeed consider both sides. But the other two questions are independent, reflecting distinct normative and practical issues. Depending on the answers to those questions, there are three possible frameworks courts could use to evaluate platform conduct while accounting for the interdependence between sides. The Amex rule is unambiguously the most flawed and impractical option of the three. The Microsoft court avoided this problematic outcome because it understood not only that indirect network effects are important, but also how to account for them properly under the rule of reason.

AI.tldr: 本文批评了美国最高法院在Amex案中要求将双边市场合并定义的裁决，指出微软案在25年前就已更巧妙地处理了平台双边市场的相互依赖问题，并提出了三种可行的分析框架，而Amex规则是最差的选择。
AI.research_question: 在涉及多边平台的 antitrust 案件中，应如何在市场界定和竞争损害评估中正确考虑双边市场的相互依赖性？
AI.motivation: Amex 案裁决要求将平台双边合并定义市场，但该规则存在严重缺陷；而微软案早已展示了如何在单边市场定义下仍充分考虑双边互动。作者试图澄清 Amex 案混淆的三个不同问题，并指出更优的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多边平台经济学、间接网络效应、规则合理分析框架、市场界定理论
AI.method: 比较案例分析法，对 Amex 案与 Microsoft 案的司法推理进行对比分析，并基于平台经济学理论推导三种可能的 antitrust 评估框架。
AI.findings: Amex 案多数意见混淆了三个独立问题：(1)是否应考虑双方；(2)一方的利益是否可豁免另一方的反竞争损害；(3)如何界定市场。平台经济学只回答了第一个问题，后两个问题涉及不同的规范与实践考量。在三种可能的框架中，Amex 规则是最有缺陷和最不实用的。微软案更正确地处理了间接网络效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 厘清了双边市场 antitrust 分析中常被混淆的三个不同层面的问题，论证了"考虑双方"与"合并市场定义"不是同一回事，为平台反垄断理论提供了更精细的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院在平台 antitrust 案件中提供了区分三种分析框架的指导，指出 Amex 合并市场规则应被避免，微软案的分析路径更具操作性。

title: Screwworms
affiliations: New York University (NYU), Department of Economics, Students

detail.title: Screwworms
detail.abstract: I show how farmers amplify the benefits of disease control in agriculture by changing their production techniques. Specifically, I examine the eradication of the screwworm, a deadly livestock parasite, in the southwestern United States. Exploiting spatial variation in infestation, I find that livestock production increased by 60 percent in initially heavily infested counties relative to less infested ones. This increase was driven by feedlot adoption, as farmers shifted to a technology which had been unviable under disease pressure. I estimate that this adaptation accounted for more than four-fifths of the total output gain.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，美国西南部根除螺旋蝇（一种致命牲畜寄生虫）后，农民通过采用饲料育肥技术，使畜牧业产量在重度感染县相对轻度感染县增长了60%，其中超过80%的产出增长来源于这种技术适应。
AI.research_question: 农民如何通过改变生产技术来放大疾病防控带来的农业收益？
AI.motivation: 理解疾病防控的真实经济效益，以及农民适应性行为在其中的关键作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 疾病防控与农业技术采用的经济学理论；技术适宜性与生产环境约束的关系。
AI.method: 利用美国西南部螺旋蝇根除行动作为准自然实验，采用空间差异分析（比较初始高感染县与低感染县）来识别因果效应。
AI.findings: （1）根除螺旋蝇后，初始高感染县的畜牧业产量相对低感染县增长了60%；（2）增长主要源于农民转向采用饲料育肥技术（此前因疾病压力而不可行）；（3）技术适应贡献了总产出增长的80%以上。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了疾病防控通过"释放技术采用约束"而非单纯减少损失来产生巨大经济收益的机制，丰富了农业生产与健康经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业疾病防控政策的成本-收益评估提供了新视角：需考虑农民适应性行为带来的间接收益，而非仅关注直接损失减少。

title: Impact of COVID-19 on the Performance of Emerging Market Mutual Funds: Evidence From India
affiliations: TKM College of Arts and Science, Kollam 5

detail.title: Impact of COVID-19 on the Performance of Emerging Market Mutual Funds: Evidence From India
detail.abstract: The purpose of this paper is to examine the widely believed beating capacity of actively managed funds during the market downturn. This popular hypothesis has been tested with the performance of Indian Equity Mutual Funds during the pandemic period. The conditional alphas are estimated using lagged instrumental variables with the fixed effect/LSDV estimator and the sys-GMM estimator in contrast to the OLS estimation from a sample of 1271 schemes for 5 months from 1st March 2020 to 31st July 2020. The study's findings indicate that the actively managed Indian mutual fund co-moves with the market and does not possess the ability to beat the market. The major implication comes from the application of fixed effect and GMM estimators for the performance evaluation of Indian Mutual Funds' during the crisis period, and it serves the investors in deciding the profitable investment opportunities.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对2020年3月至7月疫情期间1271只印度股票型共同基金的数据分析，采用固定效应/最小二乘虚拟变量估计和系统广义矩估计方法，发现积极管理型基金与市场同向波动，不具备击败市场的能力。
AI.research_question: 积极管理型基金在市场下行期间是否具备击败市场的（避险）能力？
AI.motivation: 检验"积极管理型基金在市场低迷时期表现更优"这一广泛持有的假设，为投资者在危机时期的投资决策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 条件Alpha估计理论；使用滞后工具变量的固定效应/LSDV估计和系统GMM估计方法，与传统的OLS估计进行对比。
AI.method: 样本为2020年3月1日至7月31日（5个月）的1271只印度股票型共同基金；采用固定效应/LSDV估计和系统GMM估计，利用滞后工具变量估计条件Alpha。
AI.findings: 积极管理型印度共同基金与市场同向波动，不具备击败市场的能力。即在疫情危机期间，基金管理人未能展现出优于市场的选股或择时能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将固定效应和GMM估计方法应用于危机时期共同基金绩效评估，为条件Alpha的估计提供了更稳健的计量方法，超越了传统的OLS估计。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者在危机时期识别盈利投资机会提供决策依据；表明在疫情期间投资于积极管理型基金并不能获得超额市场回报。

title: Barriers to Energy Transition in Indian Households: A Fuel-Stacking and Capability Approach Analysis Using NFHS-5 Data
affiliations: and Government of India - National Institute of Science Education and Research (NISER)

detail.title: Barriers to Energy Transition in Indian Households: A Fuel-Stacking and Capability Approach Analysis Using NFHS-5 Data
detail.abstract: India's shift from traditional to clean cooking fuels is vital for health, environmental, and development goals. Despite initiatives like Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), which distributed subsidized Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) connections to over 50 million households, many rural and low-income households still rely on polluting fuels such as wood, cow dung, and crop residues. This study investigates structural, socioeconomic, and demographic barriers to the adoption of clean fuels using micro-level data from the National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019-21). A binary logistic regression model assesses how household education, caste, religion, housing quality, electricity access, and land ownership influence clean fuels use. Results show positive associations with education, urban residence, electricity access, and better housing, while agricultural land ownership and larger household size hinder adoption. Caste and religious disparities underscore social stratification's role. Strikingly, BPL card possession does not ensure clean fuel use, revealing subsidy programs' limits without behavioral or infrastructural support. We conclude that policies must extend beyond access to promote sustained usage. Recommendations include improving last-mile delivery, redesigning refill subsidies, and linking clean energy to welfare programs with behavior change campaigns for equitable, lasting transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文基于印度NFHS-5微观数据，运用二元Logistic回归分析发现，教育、城市居住、电力接入和良好住房条件促进清洁燃料使用，而农业土地所有权和大家庭规模则阻碍采纳。研究指出，即便拥有BPL（贫困线以下）卡也不保证使用清洁燃料，揭示了补贴项目的局限性。
AI.research_question: 影响印度农村和低收入家庭采用清洁烹饪燃料的结构性、社会经济和人口障碍是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管印度政府通过PMUY计划向超过5000万家庭提供了补贴LPG连接，但许多农村和低收入家庭仍依赖木材、牛粪等污染燃料，清洁燃料转型进展有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会分层理论、技术采纳模型、能源转型理论
AI.method: 采用NFHS-5（2019-21）微观数据，运用二元Logistic回归模型分析教育、种姓、宗教、住房质量、电力接入和土地所有权等因素对清洁燃料使用的影响。
AI.findings: 教育、城市居住、电力接入和良好住房条件与清洁燃料使用正相关；农业土地所有权和大家庭规模阻碍采纳；种姓和宗教差异凸显社会分层的作用；BPL卡持有并不保证清洁燃料使用，揭示补贴项目的局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会分层视角引入清洁能源采纳研究，揭示了种姓、宗教等社会结构性因素与能源转型的交互作用；挑战了补贴即有效的传统假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议改善最后一公里配送、重新设计加气补贴、将清洁能源与福利计划挂钩，并配合行为改变宣传，以促进公平、可持续的能源转型。

title: The Impact of Road Quality on Nearby House Prices
affiliations: West Virginia University - Department of Economics and Virginia Tech

detail.title: The Impact of Road Quality on Nearby House Prices
detail.abstract: This paper estimates the impact of road quality on house prices in Hamilton County, Ohio, USA which includes the city of Cincinnati. We use a hedonic regression framework using road segmentlevel international roughness index (IRI) data as a measure of road quality. We find that rougher roads decrease house prices, with a one standard deviation increase in road roughness from the sample mean decreasing house prices by 3.5%. This equates to a $6,700 decrease in the value of an average priced home in our sample, demonstrating the importance of road quality and maintenance for local economic development.

AI.tldr: 本文利用 hedonic 回归框架，研究了美国俄亥俄州汉密尔顿县（包括辛辛那提市）道路质量对房价的影响。研究发现，道路粗糙度每增加一个标准差，房价下降 3.5%（约 6,700 美元），表明道路质量与维护对地方经济发展的重要性。
AI.research_question: 道路质量如何影响房价？
AI.motivation: 道路基础设施是地方经济发展的关键因素，但道路质量对房价的量化影响缺乏充分证据。本研究旨在填补这一空白，为地方政府基础设施投资决策提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 特征价格模型（Hedonic Pricing Model）：将房屋价格分解为各项特征（包括区位、结构、邻里环境等）的隐含价格，从而估计道路质量这一环境属性对房价的边际贡献。
AI.method: 采用特征价格回归框架，使用路段级别的国际粗糙度指数（IRI）作为道路质量的度量指标，控制其他影响房价的变量，定量估计道路粗糙度对房价的影响。
AI.findings: 道路越粗糙（质量越差），房价越低。道路粗糙度每增加一个标准差（相对于样本均值），房价下降 3.5%，相当于均价房屋价值减少约 6,700 美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 将道路质量这一基础设施特征纳入特征价格模型，为城市经济学和环境经济学中关于公共基础设施资本化效应的研究提供了新的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了道路维护对房产价值的影响，为地方政府在道路建设与养护方面的投资决策提供了成本-收益分析依据，强调了基础设施质量对地方经济发展的重要性。

title: Co-Evolutionary Market Intelligence via Topological LLM-Agent Ensembles with Behavioural Non-Stationarity Adaptation

detail.title: Co-Evolutionary Market Intelligence via Topological LLM-Agent Ensembles with Behavioural Non-Stationarity Adaptation
detail.abstract: Financial markets are co-evolutionary systems: the strategies participants deploy reshape price dynamics, which in turn erode the very edges those strategies were built to exploit. This feedback is not distributional drift-the standard target of adaptive deep-learning methods-but strategic non-stationarity, a distinction that is, in our view, categorically more fundamental. No existing framework treats it as the primary design constraint. That gap motivates this work. We introduce the Co-Evolutionary Portfolio Policy (CEPP), an architecture that models markets as open-ended evolutionary games and constructs agents that adapt to the game's generative structure rather than its historical instances. Three modules constitute the system. First, a topological data analysis (TDA) pipeline constructs Vietoris-Rips filtrations over Bitcoin UTXO transaction graphs and limit-order-book depth profiles, vectorising persistence images stable under Hausdorff perturbation (Cohen-Steiner stability theorem); features empirically precede market dislocations by 2-3 trading days. Second, a chain-ofthought LLM reasoning layer converts macroeconomic narratives into Dirichlet-parameterised behavioural priors, injected as annealed KL-penalty constraints on the RL policy objective with confidence-gated hallucination guards; Theorem 2 establishes a formal bound on hallucination-induced policy divergence. Third, CR-EVO-a CMA-ES × PSO hybrid-minimises counterfactual regret against a best-response oracle, with a formal O ∆ f T log(N/δ) + εT regret bound (Theorem 1). Evaluated on equities, cryptocurrency, and commodity futures over a strict 2020-2024 out-of-sample window (1,258 trading days), CEPP achieves an annualised Sharpe ratio of 1.000 versus 0.761 for baseline PPO-DRL, with positive alpha across five structurally distinct regimes: the 2020 COVID crash, the 2020-21 recovery, the 2022 rate-hike cycle, the 2022 crypto winter, and the 2024 rate-reversal. TDA features alone improve baseline Sharpe from 0.761 to 0.863 (+13.4%), reproducible from public Blockchair data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CEPP架构，将金融市场建模为开放式演化博弈，通过拓扑数据分析、大语言模型推理和混合进化优化三个模块，在2020-2024年五个不同市场制度中实现夏普比率1.000，优于PPO-DRL基准的0.761。
AI.research_question: 如何在非平稳、策略共演化的金融市场中设计持续适应市场生成结构而非历史实例的交易智能体？
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法仅处理分布漂移（distributional drift），而金融市场中的策略共演化导致的是更根本的战略非平稳性（strategic non-stationarity），且无现有框架将其作为首要设计约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放式演化博弈论、拓扑数据分析（持续同调、Vietoris-Rips过滤、持久性图像）、强化学习（KL惩罚约束策略优化）、博弈论（反事实遗憾最小化）、CMA-ES与PSO混合进化算法。
AI.method: CEPP三模块架构：（1）TDA管道：对Bitcoin UTXO交易图和限价订单簿深度剖面构建Vietoris-Rips过滤，生成持久性图像特征；（2）LLM推理层：链式思考过程将宏观经济叙事转化为Dirichlet参数化行为先验，通过退火KL惩罚约束RL策略目标，并设置置信度门控幻觉防护；（3）CR-EVO：CMA-ES×PSO混合算法最小化反事实遗憾，附带形式化遗憾界。
AI.findings: 在2020-2024年1,258个交易日的股票、加密货币和商品期货样本外测试中，CEPP年化夏普比率1.000，优于PPO-DRL基准的0.761；在2020年新冠疫情崩盘等五个结构性不同制度下均产生正alpha；TDA特征单独提升基准夏普比率13.4%。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将金融市场中的策略非平稳性形式化，与标准分布漂移区分；（2）证明幻觉诱导策略偏离的形式化界（Theorem 2）；（3）证明混合进化算法CR-EVO的遗憾界O(∆√(fT log(N/δ) + εT))（Theorem 1）；
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提出可直接部署的交易智能体架构；（2）TDA特征可提前2-3个交易日预警市场脱位；（3）基于公开Blockchair数据可复现的实证结果。

title: StreamShield: A Real-Time IoT Streaming Framework for Global Supply Chain Disruption Detection via Multi-Modal Data Fusion

detail.title: StreamShield: A Real-Time IoT Streaming Framework for Global Supply Chain Disruption Detection via Multi-Modal Data Fusion

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No competing interests
declarations.funderStatement: No one has funded this research

detail.abstract: Existing supply chain monitoring infrastructure is built for periodic reporting, not for the sub-day detection latency that modern disruptions demand. StreamShield closes this gap as a real-time IoT-style streaming framework that identifies and classifies supply chain disruptions through continuous fusion of seven heterogeneous data stream types: commodity futures, shipping equities, freight rate proxies, foreign exchange stress indicators, logistics equities, geopolitical event feeds (GDELT), and public attention signals (Wikipedia pageviews). The Supply Chain Stress Index (SCSI), a composite scoring metric at the core of the system, unifies per-stream Isolation Forest anomaly scores through weighted aggregation, exponential moving average smoothing, and a four-tier calibrated alert hierarchy. Retrospective replay-mode evaluation across four historically significant events-the 2021 Suez Canal blockage, the 2022 Russia-Ukraine supply shock, the 2023 Red Sea maritime security crisis, and COVID-19 port bottlenecks (2020-21)-demonstrates HIGH-tier detection at zero-day latency for two acute events (peak SCSI 0.611 and 0.592 respectively), ELEVATED-tier detection within one day for a sustained maritime security crisis, and correct Normal classification during gradual logistical stress accumulation. False positive rates at the HIGH threshold are 0.00 across all pre-event baseline windows. Taken together, these results demonstrate that purpose-built IoT streaming architectures can materially advance the temporal frontier of operational supply chain situational awareness.

AI.tldr: StreamShield是一个基于IoT流式架构的实时供应链中断检测框架，通过融合七类异构数据流并构建供应链压力指数（SCSI），能够在零天延迟内检测急性供应链中断事件，在四个历史事件回测中展现出高精度和低误报率。
AI.research_question: 如何利用实时IoT流式架构和异构数据融合技术，将供应链中断检测的延迟从周期性报告（数天级）缩短至亚天级（sub-day），实现近乎实时的运营态势感知？
AI.motivation: 现有供应链监控基础设施基于周期性报告构建，无法满足现代供应链中断所需的亚天级检测延迟，亟需一种能够实时识别和分类供应链中断的新型架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: Isolation Forest异常检测算法、加权聚合与指数移动平均平滑、四层校准预警层级体系、IoT流式数据处理理论。
AI.method: 构建StreamShield实时流式框架：融合七类异构数据流（商品期货、航运股权、运费代理、外汇压力指标、物流股权、地缘政治事件GDELT、公众关注度Wikipedia浏览量）；通过Isolation Forest计算各流异常分数，经加权聚合和指数移动平均平滑构建SCSI综合评分；设置四层校准预警阈值；采用回顾式回放模式对四个历史事件进行验证。
AI.findings: 急性事件（2021苏伊士运河堵塞、2022俄乌供应冲击）实现零天延迟HIGH级检测（峰值SCSI分别为0.611和0.592）；持续性危机（2023红海安全危机）一天内实现ELEVATED级检测；渐进性物流压力积累正确归类为Normal；所有事件基线窗口的HIGH阈值误报率为0.00。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于IoT流式架构的实时供应链中断检测理论框架，验证了多源异构数据融合可以显著提升供应链情境感知的时间分辨率，拓展了运营供应链管理中的实时检测理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了零天延迟的供应链中断实时检测工具，显著降低误报率；四层预警体系为不同紧急程度的供应链事件提供差异化响应策略；为供应链管理人员提供了超越传统周期性报告的实时态势感知能力。

title: Playing it Safe? The Effect of Abortion Bans on Sexual Behavior
affiliations: Miami University of Ohio - Richard T. Farmer School of Business Administration, Middlebury College and Middlebury College

detail.title: Playing it Safe? The Effect of Abortion Bans on Sexual Behavior
detail.abstract:
We estimate the effect of total abortion bans enacted after Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health on sexual behavior. Using synthetic and standard difference-in-differences designs, we analyze gonorrhea rates and over-the-counter contraceptive purchases as indicators of sexual activity and contraceptive use. We find that total abortion bans reduced gonorrhea rates by 21% among the population aged 15–44 and increased condom purchases by 5.4%. County-level analyses suggest the response reflects awareness of state policy rather than changes in travel distance to providers. These findings are consistent with a framework in which abortion restrictions increase the perceived cost of unprotected sex, inducing more cautious behavior.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用合成控制法和双重差分法，发现Dobbs案后实施的全额堕胎禁令使15-44岁人群的淋病发病率下降21%，避孕套购买量增加5.4%，表明堕胎限制提高了不安全性行为的感知成本，促使人们采取更谨慎的性行为。
AI.research_question: Dobbs案后实施的全额堕胎禁令如何影响人们的性行为？
AI.motivation: Dobbs案推翻了罗诉韦德案，使多个州实施了严格的堕胎禁令，亟需评估这些政策对人们性行为的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 堕胎限制会提高不安全性行为的感知成本（意外怀孕风险上升），从而诱导更谨慎的性行为，如减少无保护性行为或增加避孕套使用。
AI.method: 采用合成控制法和标准双重差分法，以淋病发病率（作为无保护性行为的指标）和非处方避孕套购买量作为被解释变量进行分析。
AI.findings: 全额堕胎禁令使15-44岁人群淋病发病率降低21%，避孕套购买量增加5.4%；效应主要源于政策知晓而非就医距离变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"堕胎限制通过改变性行为成本感知影响行为"的理论提供了实证证据，拓展了法律政策对健康行为影响的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了堕胎禁令的意外后果，为政策制定者评估堕胎政策的社会影响提供参考，尤其是对性传播疾病和避孕行为的现实效应。

title: Spectral PELVE and Cross-Border Tail-Shape Connectedness in Global Equity Markets
affiliations: Izmir Bakircay University/Department of Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Spectral PELVE and Cross-Border Tail-Shape Connectedness in Global Equity Markets
detail.abstract: We propose a spectral framework for monitoring the cross-border transmission of tail-shape risk among international equity markets, oriented toward financial-stability surveillance. The framework combines the Probability Equivalent Level of Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall (PELVE), a location- and scale-invariant index of tail shape motivated by the Basel III FRTB shift from VaR to ES, with wavelet multiresolution analysis and a time-varying parameter vector autoregression (TVP-VAR). Applying the framework to fifteen markets partitioned into G7, structurally intermediate, and BRICS blocks over 2012-2026, we document four findings of relevance to systemic-risk monitoring. First, block-average PELVE lies above the Gaussian tail-shape benchmark at the 5% tail level and above the FRTB-motivated probability-multiplier reference, rising markedly once the COVID-19 shock enters the rolling estimation window. This pattern is pervasive across blocks and horizons, consistent with the prudential rationale for the VaR-to-ES transition. Second, the G7 block is the largest net transmitter of tail-shape spillovers at every investment horizon, while the structurally intermediate and BRICS blocks absorb comparable spillovers at short and medium horizons but diverge at the longer-horizon component, where the intermediate block absorbs more. Third, the two reported crisis regimes are associated with opposing connectedness patterns: the COVID-19 window is associated with a total connectedness index up to 20 percentage points above tranquil levels, consistent with broad-based synchronization, whereas the Russia--Ukraine window is associated with lower connectedness and a smaller BRICS contribution to cross-block spillovers, consistent with fragmentation. Fourth, comparing the G7-BRICS core with the full system shows that the structurally intermediate block adds 13.8 to 16.4 percentage points of measured system connectedness, so that surveillance frameworks omitting such markets may understate global tail-shape connectedness. The framework provides a market-based, frequency-resolved diagnostic indicator that can support financial-stability surveillance of cross-border tail-shape risk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个结合PELVE指标、小波多分辨率分析和TVP-VAR的频谱框架，用于监测国际股市尾部风险跨境传染。通过对2012-2026年G7、结构中间体和金砖国家三个板块的分析，发现：G7是尾部风险溢出净输出者；COVID-19期间市场高度同步，而俄乌冲突期间则呈现碎片化；忽略结构中间体板块会低估全球尾部风险关联度。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个面向金融稳定监测的频谱框架，以有效监测国际股市尾部风险的跨境传染？
AI.motivation: 巴塞尔III的FRTB协议从VaR转向ES，需要一种位置和尺度不变的尾部形状指数来监测跨境尾部风险传播，现有方法缺乏频率分辨能力且难以全面捕捉多市场、多周期的风险联动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概率等效水平的VaR与ES (PELVE)指标、小波多分辨率分析、时变参数向量自回归模型 (TVP-VAR)。
AI.method: 将PELVE（基于FRTB从VaR向ES转移的动机构建的位置和尺度不变的尾部形状指数）与小波多分辨率分析及TVP-VAR相结合，对15个市场（分为G7、结构中间体、金砖国家三个板块）在2012-2026年期间的数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 1) 各板块平均PELVE在5%尾部水平上高于高斯基准和FRTB概率乘数参考值，COVID-19冲击后显著上升；2) G7板块是所有投资周期中最大的尾部风险溢出净输出者；3) COVID-19期间总连通性指数高于平静期20个百分点（同步化），俄乌冲突期间连通性较低且金砖国家溢出贡献减少（碎片化）；4) 结构中间体板块贡献了13.8-16.4个百分点的系统连通性，忽略该板块会低估全球尾部风险关联度。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将PELVE指数与小波多分辨率分析和TVP-VAR结合，构建了频率分辨的尾部风险跨境监测框架，揭示了不同危机时期尾部风险传播的同步化与碎片化差异模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融稳定监管提供了市场化的、频率分辨的诊断指标，可用于监测跨境尾部风险；揭示了忽略结构中间体市场（如G7和BRICS之外的市场）将严重低估全球尾部风险关联度，对监管机构有重要政策启示。

title: From Trade War to Green Transition: Optimal Electric Vehicle Tariffs with Revenue-Funded Subsidies
affiliations: Cornell University - Department of Economics, University of Wisconsin-Madison - Department of Economics, Yale University - Department of Economics, Stanford University and

detail.title: From Trade War to Green Transition: Optimal Electric Vehicle Tariffs with Revenue-Funded Subsidies
detail.abstract:
We study the optimal design of trade and industrial policy when governments pursue environmental objectives alongside traditional welfare goals. Motivated by the global transition to electric vehicles (EVs) and growing concerns about competitiveness, energy security, and climate change, we develop a framework in which policymakers choose tariffs and domestic production subsidies to maximize welfare, defined as the sum of consumer surplus, domestic profits, environmental benefits, and tariff revenue. We combine a theoretical model of differentiated-product oligopoly with a structural demand model estimated using vehicle-level data from 13 countries that together account for the vast majority of global EV sales. Our central finding is that the optimal policy combines a moderate tariff on imported EVs with a subsidy to domestic EV production financed through tariff revenue. This policy substantially outperforms both outright protectionism and laissez-faire. Relative to current policies, it preserves consumer access to affordable EVs, accelerates fleet electrification, supports domestic producers, and remains budget-neutral. For the United States, the optimal policy more than doubles EV market share, generates over $45 billion in annual welfare gains, and avoids approximately 95 million tons of lifetime CO2 emissions. A key mechanism underlying these results is the pass-through of tariffs and subsidies to prices, which depends critically on demand curvature, product substitution, and market structure. More broadly, our results suggest that effective industrial policy requires careful attention to market structure and country-specific conditions, balancing consumer, producer, fiscal, and environmental objectives rather than adhering to ideological prescriptions.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了政府同时追求环境目标与传统福利目标时，贸易与产业政策的最优设计。以全球电动汽车转型为背景，结合理论模型与多国结构需求估计，发现最优政策是"适度进口关税+国内生产补贴"，该政策显著优于保护主义或自由放任，对美国而言可提升两倍以上市场份额、带来超450亿美元年福利收益并减少约9500万吨碳排放。
AI.research_question: 当政府将环境目标与传统福利目标（消费者剩余、国内利润、关税收入）共同纳入考量时，最优的贸易与产业政策（关税与国内生产补贴）应如何设计？
AI.motivation: 全球向电动汽车转型过程中，各国面临竞争力、能源安全与气候变化的复杂权衡，现有政策常陷入保护主义与自由放任的意识形态争论，缺乏兼顾环境与经济效益的最优政策设计研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 差异化产品寡头竞争理论；结构需求模型；福利经济学框架（消费者剩余+国内利润+环境收益+关税收入）
AI.method: 理论模型推导最优政策条件；结合13个主要电动汽车销售国家的车型层面数据估计结构需求模型；反事实政策模拟与福利分析。
AI.findings: 最优政策为适度进口关税与国内生产补贴的组合，显著优于保护主义或自由放任；需求曲率、产品替代性与市场结构是关税和补贴传导至价格的关键机制；对美国而言，最优政策可使EV市场份额翻倍以上、年福利收益超450亿美元、减少约9500万吨生命周期CO2排放，且保持预算中性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将环境目标系统性地纳入贸易与产业政策的最优设计框架，揭示了关税-补贴组合在寡头市场中的传导机制依赖于需求曲率与市场结构，为"战略性环境政策"理论提供了微观基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国（尤其是美国）设计兼顾环境与经济效益的电动汽车产业政策提供了可操作的具体方案（适度关税+补贴，预算中性）；证明了超越意识形态（保护主义vs自由放任）的务实政策路径是可行的且高效的。

title: A Comprehensive Global Assessment of Financial Mechanisms for Green Financial Recovery and Climate Change Mitigation: Insights from the Case Study of China
affiliations: Fudan University

detail.title: A Comprehensive Global Assessment of Financial Mechanisms for Green Financial Recovery and Climate Change Mitigation: Insights from the Case Study of China
detail.abstract: As nations increasingly resume life and industrial production post-pandemic, the effects of climate change have exacerbated health crises globally, highlighting the urgent need for green economic recovery measures. This article explores the environmental and economic implications of climate change across different regions of China, both in the present and looking ahead. Utilizing a popular computable general equilibrium (CGE) method, this study examines the post-pandemic effects of various fiscal strategies—including revenue losses and increased spending—alongside the implementation of a carbon tax.The global economic shocks experienced from March 21, 2020, to July 3, 2021, have significantly disadvantaged regional economies worldwide. Our empirical findings reveal that the economic impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic have been sustained and are likely to further inhibit economic activity.Notably, among the government's recovery strategies, reductions in indirect taxes have proven most beneficial to regional economies, particularly in areas targeted for zero carbon emissions. Additionally, strategies aimed at minimizing the damage from green economic recovery could benefit from substituting indirect production taxes with carbon taxes. We develop long-term indicators to measure performance against standard global economic metrics, and our empirical results indicate a significant correlation with economic recovery indicators, offering important policy implications.

AI.tldr: 本文利用可计算一般均衡（CGE）方法，研究中国各地区在后疫情时代气候变化背景下的绿色经济复苏策略，发现减免间接税对区域经济最有利，并提出用碳税替代间接生产税的优化方案。
AI.research_question: 后疫情时代，中国各地区如何通过财政策略（如碳税、间接税减免等）实现绿色经济复苏，并应对气候变化带来的环境与经济影响？
AI.motivation: 疫情后各国恢复生产生活，但气候变化加剧了全球健康危机，亟需绿色经济复苏措施。现有研究缺乏对中国不同区域在疫情冲击与气候变化双重压力下财政政策效果的系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型；碳税与间接税替代理论；绿色经济复苏框架。
AI.method: 采用可计算一般均衡（CGE）方法，模拟2020年3月至2021年7月全球/中国区域经济冲击，分析不同财政策略（收入损失、支出增加、碳税实施）的后疫情效应。
AI.findings: 1）COVID-19的经济冲击具有持续性，将进一步抑制经济活动；2）政府复苏策略中，减免间接税对区域经济最有益，尤其在零碳目标区域；3）用碳税替代间接生产税可最小化绿色经济复苏的损害；4）长期经济指标与复苏指标显著相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了CGE模型在疫情-气候双重冲击下的应用；提出间接税减免与碳税替代的绿色复苏理论机制；构建了长期经济复苏绩效指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国各地区后疫情时代的绿色财政政策设计提供实证依据，建议优先采用间接税减免配合碳税替代策略，以实现经济复苏与碳中和目标的协同。
